title: JSON files in git, not SQLite
context: The dashboard must open as a static file with no server, data must diff and merge in git, and it must follow branches and worktrees.
decision: Store records as JSON. Revisit a SQLite cache only if a repo grows past tens of thousands of records.
consequences: Readable diffs and no binary files in git. Queries scan files, which is fine at expected sizes.
author: noreply@anthropic.com
